input.question: Why does it take hours to install big programs and games but seconds to uninstall it?
input.ground_truth: When you are installing a game, you are writing the files to your hard drive. It has to remember where to access those files. The uninstallation is just forgetting those locations on your drive, not actually erasing them.

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Why does it take hours to install big programs and games but seconds to uninstall it?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay, let’s imagine you have a big toy box full of blocks. When you want to put all the blocks into the toy box, you have to pick up each block one by one and put them inside. That takes a long time because there are so many blocks!

But when you want to empty the toy box, you just open the lid and all the blocks fall out quickly. That’s much faster.

Installing a big program or game is like putting all the blocks into the toy box—it takes time because there are lots of pieces to put in the right place. Uninstalling is like taking all the blocks out of the box, which is much quicker because you just take everything away at once.
